name: llava_pretrain_zhtw
description: A multimodal pretraining dataset focused on Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) image–text pairs intended to support vision-language model training (e.g., LLaVA-style models). It measures image-caption alignment and provides data for instruction tuning of multimodal LLMs in Traditional Chinese. Primarily used for pretraining and fine-tuning rather than as a direct evaluation benchmark.
reputation: A community-contributed pretraining corpus with limited but growing use in Chinese/Taiwanese multimodal model development.
